text.p: Following is a summary of major Shanghai political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The securities authorities issue new rules banning people found to have engaged in serious securities irregularities from holding senior positions in the industry or from trading.

- Spokesman for the China Securities Regulatory Commission said the new rules banning serious violators from the industry is aimed at standardising the securities markets to protect the interests of retail investors.
- Editorial hails the new rules as effective measures to help clean up the securities markets.
- Share indices on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges rose solidly on Monday due to heavy buying from individuals.
- BUSINESS NEWS - The debt-asset ratio of China's state commercial companies as a whole has hit 82.15 percent, far exceeding an average of 35 percent in the developed countries.
- Retail buyers account for 60 percent of total purchases of homes in Shanghai.
- Shanghai Cooperative Bank has bought a piece of land in the Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone in Pudong to build its headquarters, the ninth domestic bank planning to move to Pudong.
